$description: aberson-profile brand - extends the shared on-brand house-docs preset, with a LOCAL indigo brand-ramp override (seed #3730a3, generated via on-brand buildBrandRamp). Only color.primitive.brand + color.semantic.accent are overridden here; neutral/status/chart/diagram stay inherited from house-docs. The diagram palette (color.diagram) still lives in exactly ONE place (on-brand/templates/presets/house-docs); this project inherits it wholesale. The README <picture> core-pipeline SVGs under assets/ are regenerated from brand/dist/diagram-palette.json by scripts/regen-diagrams.mjs.

brand.$description: Indigo brand ramp (OKLCH seed #3730a3), 12 steps light-to-dark. Local override of the inherited house-docs blue ramp; regenerate with on-brand buildBrandRamp, not by hand.

categorical.$description: Eight intentionally related, indigo-led series colours: cool brand relatives first, then muted signal accents for chart distinction.
